              function setPopupCookie(name, value, days){
                  if (days) {
                      var date = new Date();
                      date.setTime(date.getTime()+(days*24*60*60*1000));
                      var expires = "; expires="+date.toGMTString();
                  }
                  else var expires = "";
                  document.cookie = name+"="+value+expires+"; path=/";
              }

              function getPopupCookie(by_name){
                  var nameEQ = by_name + "=";
                  var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
                  for(var i=0;i < ca.length;i++) {
                      var c = ca[i];
                      while (c.charAt(0)==' ') c = c.substring(1,c.length);
                      if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) == 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length,c.length);
                  }
                  return null;
              }

                  url = arr[arr.length-1].split('?')[0];
                  
                  if(action == "cancel"){ 
                      setCookie(url, (1*24*60*60*1000));
                      $("#app-banner").hide();
                  }else if(action == "autocheck"){
                    if(getCookie(url) == 1){
                        $("#app-banner").hide();
                     }else{
                        $("#app-banner").show();
                     }
                  } 
              } 

              function setbanner(url, action){
                  url = url.replace('http://');
                  arr = url.split('/'); 
                  url = arr[arr.length-1].split('?')[0];
                  
                  if(action == "cancel"){ 
                     setCookie(url, (12*60*60*1000));
                       $('#overlay').modal('hide');
                  }else if(action == "autocheck"){
                      if(getCookie(url) == 1){
                       $('#overlay').modal('hide');
                     } else{
                       $('#overlay').modal('show');
                       setTimeout(function() {
                            $('#overlay').modal('hide');
                       }, 3000);
                       setCookie(url, (12*60*60*1000));
                     } 
                  }   
              }

                var searchTerm = searchText.value.toLowerCase();
                $(".brands_ul").find('li').each(function () {
                    var listText = $(this).text().toLowerCase();
                      $(this).closest('.brand_li')[listText.indexOf(searchTerm) !== -1 ? 'show' : 'hide']();
                      $(this).prev('.brand_type')[listText.indexOf(searchTerm) !== -1 ? 'show' : 'hide']();
                });
              }

              function getCookie(name) {
                  var value = "; " + document.cookie;
                  var parts = value.split("; " + name + "=");
                  if (parts.length == 2)
                      return parts.pop().split(";").shift();
              }  
              
              function setCookie(name, estime) {
                    var cookieName = name;
                    $('#app-banner').hide();
                    var date = new Date();
                    date.setTime(date.getTime() + (estime));
                    var expires = " expires=" + date.toGMTString();
                    document.cookie = cookieName+"=1;" + expires + "; path=/"; 
              }
